board.name: New Hampshire Board of Medicine (via the Office of Professional Licensure and Certification); PAs are titled Physician Associates under RSA 328-D

licence.title: Physician Associate (P.A.) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: 2 years from date of issuance (RSA 310:8, II); renewal must be filed on or before expiration

ce.categoryRules: Either maintain NCCPA certification, OR 100 hours approved CME per renewal period with at least 40 Category 1 and no more than 60 Category 2. Approved activities: AAPA Category 1, AMA PRA Category 1, AOA 1-A, AAFP Prescribed, or board approved. Tracked in CE Broker.
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: No PA specific opioid or controlled substance CE found in Med 613.01 (the 3 hour PDMP registrant rule in Med 402.01 applies to physicians).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written collaboration agreement with a NH licensed physician in a similar area of medicine required only for PAs with fewer than 8,000 post graduate clinical hours who practice without at least one NH physician in the group, practice or health system. Kept on file at the practice, provided to the board on request, updated as necessary; not filed with the board.
practice.notes: Until Jan 1, 2027, a PA with more than 8,000 hours practicing in a setting with no NH physician must obtain a board waiver of the collaboration agreement requirement; that waiver paragraph drops out of the version effective Jan 1, 2027. New Hampshire adopted the Physician Associate Licensure Compact (RSA 328-D:18-a).

prescribing.ceForPrescribers: None for PAs. Med 613.01 (eff 10-2-25) has no opioid CE; RSA 318-B:40, the former prescriber competency statute, reads '[Omitted.]'. PAs who prescribe Schedule II-IV must register with the NH PDMP (RSA 126-A:91, II) and with DEA (RSA 328-D:3-b, XVI).

facts.value: Biennial renewal

facts.quote: certified for American Academy of Physician Assistants (AAPA) Category 1 credit, American Medical Association (AMA) Category 1 PRA credit

facts.quote: Whether or not the applicant has registered with the Controlled Drug Health and Safety Program also known as the N.H. Prescription Drug Monitoring Program.

facts.quote: Section: 328-D:18-a Physician Associate Licensure Compact Adopted.

facts.value: PDMP registration required for Schedule II-IV prescribers (a registration with the program, not a CS licence)
facts.quote: All prescribers and dispensers authorized to prescribe or dispense schedule II-IV controlled substances within the state shall be required to register with the program

facts.value: PAs who prescribe or dispense CS register with DEA and any applicable state CS authority
facts.quote: Physician associates who prescribe and/or dispense controlled substances shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration

facts.quote: Section: 318-B:3 Licensing of Manufacturers and Wholesalers Required.
facts.reason: Inferred: the NH Controlled Drug Act licenses only manufacturers and wholesalers and has no practitioner registration section; no page states in words that NH issues no practitioner CS registration.

facts.value: Former prescriber competency statute omitted

board.name: New Hampshire Board of Nursing (via the Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rn.renewalDeadline: Midnight on the licensee's birthday in the renewal year
rn.ceNotes: Current national certification may be used to fulfil the RN CE requirement (Nur 403.01(a)).

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse)
aprn.renewalDeadline: Midnight on the licensee's birthday in the renewal year
aprn.ceNotes: 30 APRN contact hours in addition to the 30 RN hours (60 total), at least 20 specialty specific and 5 pharmacology, within 2 years before application. National certification may count as 30 of the 60 hours (Nur 401.03(b)).
aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: true if licensed after September 1984 (Nur 401.03(a)(2)); lifetime certificate holders must document continuing participation in the certification process (Nur 401.03(a)(3))

prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: No APRN opioid or controlled substance CE hour requirement in RSA 326-B:31 or Nur 401.03/403.01. APRNs prescribing Schedule II-IV must register with the NH PDMP (RSA 126-A:91, II).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: None required; APRNs hold plenary prescriptive authority under RSA 326-B:11, III.

facts.value: 30 hours every 2 years
facts.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

facts.value: Additional 30 hours every 2 years: 20 specialty, 5 pharmacology
facts.quote: shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years, 20 hours of which shall be specific to the specialty
At least 20 of the 30 hours shall be specific to the specialty practice area, and 5 hours shall be education in pharmacology

facts.value: Current national certification required at renewal if licensed after September 1984; lifetime certificate holders document continuing participation
facts.quote: Document current national certification if licensed after September 1984

facts.value: National certification may count as 30 of 60 hours
facts.quote: may be counted as 30 of the 60 contact hours required

facts.value: Midnight on the licensee's birthday in the renewal year
facts.quote: By midnight on the applicants date of birth in the renewal year submit a completed renewal application
facts.note: RSA 310:8, II (amended 2025) makes OPLC licences valid 2 years from issuance and says those terms supersede conflicting board terms; the Board of Nursing rule still states the birthday deadline. Treat the birthday date as the Board's rule; OPLC's own page could not be loaded (HTTP 403).

facts.quote: All license renewals shall be issued every 2 years in accordance with RSA 310:8.
all applicants for renewal of license as an RN or LPN shall comply with the Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) Model Rules

facts.value: full (plenary prescriptive authority, no agreement requirement found)
facts.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs

facts.value: Board recognized national certification required for initial licence
facts.quote: Be currently certified by a board-recognized national certifying body in the specialty for which the applicant was educated

facts.value: PDMP registration required for Schedule II-IV prescribers
facts.quote: Practitioners who prescribe but do not dispense schedule II-IV controlled substances shall register with the program as a prescriber

facts.value: Nurse Licensure Compact enacted in statute
facts.quote: Section: 326-B:46 Nurse Licensure Compact.

NP: 'full' practice authority is derived from RSA 326-B:11, III (plenary prescriptive authority) and the absence of any collaboration requirement in RSA 326-B; no board page using the word 'full' was loaded.
